job.name: ownershipcheck
job.script:
#!/bin/bash echo "Validating code ownership rules..."
if [ -z "$REPO_ROOT" ]; then echo "ERROR: REPO_ROOT environment variable is not set." exit 1 fi
if [ ! -d "$REPO_ROOT" ]; then echo "ERROR: REPO_ROOT is not a valid directory." exit 1 fi
REPO_ROOT="$(realpath "$REPO_ROOT")"
cd "$REPO_ROOT" PR_AUTHOR="$(git log -1 --pretty=format:'%an')" echo "PR_AUTHOR: $PR_AUTHOR" echo "Checking ownership for author: $PR_AUTHOR"
CODEOWNERS_FILE=""
if [ -f "$REPO_ROOT/CODEOWNERS" ]; then CODEOWNERS_FILE="$REPO_ROOT/CODEOWNERS" elif [ -f "$REPO_ROOT/.github/CODEOWNERS" ]; then CODEOWNERS_FILE="$REPO_ROOT/.github/CODEOWNERS" elif [ -f "$REPO_ROOT/docs/CODEOWNERS" ]; then CODEOWNERS_FILE="$REPO_ROOT/docs/CODEOWNERS" fi
if [ -z "$CODEOWNERS_FILE" ]; then echo "ERROR: No CODEOWNERS file found" echo "Please add a CODEOWNERS file to define ownership rules" echo "reject" | tee /pr-status/status exit 1 fi
echo "Found CODEOWNERS file at ${CODEOWNERS_FILE#$REPO_ROOT/}"
echo 'Code ownership check passed for {%= app_name %}'
